methodology.scene: shared engine Render IR geometry + Float32 transforms/colors; deterministic 60-tick physics snapshot
methodology.schedule: RAF, fresh document/device per case, rotated backend order per repetition
methodology.gpuTime: sum of render/compute pass timestamps; common asynchronous eight-slot ring; excludes queue gaps and copy-only commands
methodology.cpuTime: wall time of camera update and render call, including common hooks; timestamp resolve/readback overhead reported separately
methodology.uploads: GPUQueue.writeBuffer/writeTexture requested bytes; external-image estimates separate
methodology.fps: 1000 / mean RAF interval; native headless Chromium scheduling, not a presentation/VSync guarantee
methodology.quality: identical scene inputs, different native render pipelines; canonical screenshots and pixel differences are descriptive, not an equal-quality gate
methodology.correctness: source/replay/geometry/environment hashes, actual instance matrices/geometry, right-handed view and WebGPU projection audits, no software adapter, >=95% GPU timestamps
